checks.name: Every workspace manifest dependency exactly pinned and matches lock metadata
All present registry packages have their locked version
Missing registry packages are optional platform packages
Fresh browser graph excludes tests, fixtures, CLI, MetaMask and server/legacy device code
Emitted code has no known public seed fixture or RPC credential config markers
.github/workflows/ci.yml: actions pinned by complete commit SHA
.github/workflows/ledger-review.yml: actions pinned by complete commit SHA
Host CI suppresses npm installation lifecycle scripts

limits: Structural tarball integrity and installed package version checks do not authenticate installed file contents.
No dependency installation/update, native toolchain/build/emulator, physical Ledger, secrets, live indexer, deployment or fund movement.
Only known public fixture markers and reachable module paths are screened; this is not universal secret detection.
This is source-bound software evidence, not human audit, vendor approval or release qualification.
